intelligence.human_view: He challenged the choice and then answered his own challenge: whichever icons, the white in the middle is what makes the tile pop — the white disc is the jewel's face, the glyph sits in it in the tile's own colour, and the eye reads it at a glance. The numbers are the same idea: a black (obsidian) badge with the white number in it, so the count pops instead of washing out. And the mail page's banner-in-a-banner was wasted space at the top of a page that should be extraordinary — a high-level app starts flush, like the rest, with no room spent explaining itself. Three small rulings, one standard: what pops is white on dark, and what is at the top is the work, not the frame.
intelligence.simple_view: The little tiles keep their white middles — that's what makes them pop! And the numbers go in black circles with white numbers, so they pop too. And the mail page starts right at the top, no big empty banner — straight to the mail!
intelligence.grandma_view: The little tiles keep their white middles, dear — that's what makes them pop! And the numbers go in black circles with white numbers, so they pop too. And the mail page starts right at the top, no big empty banner — straight to the mail!
